description: Replace torch.geqrf with a Triton batched Householder QR path specialized for n=32,176,352, using one program per matrix or panel to cut PyTorch launch overhead while preserving compact geqrf factors.
Implement a Triton blocked panel QR for n=512 and n=1024 batched cases, computing FP32 reflectors and tiled trailing updates to outperform torch.geqrf on high-batch benchmark shapes.

Add Triton structure-aware fast paths for upper-triangular, rank-deficient, clustered, and near-rank cases, skipping redundant QR work where safe while falling back to torch.geqrf for risky dense or mixed matrices.

Add cheap Triton or Python dispatch for provably safe structures such as zero, diagonal, identity, and already upper-triangular matrices, directly emitting geqrf-compatible compact factors and tau while falling back otherwise.

Profile baseline rankdef/clustered/nearrank n=512/1024, then add a Triton per-matrix column-norm/diagonal classifier that only handles provably tiny dependent trailing columns by constructing interface-compatible geqrf outputs and falls back to torch.geqrf for dense, mixed, or uncertain matrices.

Extend the winning fixed 3n/4 trailing-tiny path into a conservative multi-rank classifier for n=1024 nearrank/clustered cases: use Triton column/block norm scans to select among a few safe leading ranks, batch/group matching matrices for rectangular geqrf plus padded H/tau, and fall back for ambiguous, dense, or accuracy-risky inputs.

Combine a3fb29d global-best Triton QR32 one-program Householder path with eef93a9 best structured rank-deficient n=512 classifier: preserve exact QR32 dispatch for n=32, graft the n/2+2 trailing-tiny classifier before the 3n/4 rankdef path for clustered/rankdef n=512, validate mixed dispatch interactions, then profile only remaining non-n=1024 bottlenecks without touching active n=1024 multi-rank work.

Extend the QR32 Triton path from parent a3fb29d95cd7cf01c5a1a56ee60e30741ec4a827 toward dense benchmark n=176 and n=352 by adding a fixed-size blocked Householder/TSQR-style Triton panel path with conservative dispatch gates; preserve existing QR32 behavior and torch.geqrf fallback, and only keep the new path where it validates and benchmarks faster.

Combine parents e0b14b4e9359ce99bb76a0f5ac81dce238c380be and df1d9e3c7066c18552a129989668f8704bf9cbd3: integrate the validated padded power-of-two Triton QR176 path into the QR32+n512 structured-rank implementation, preserving QR32 fallback, QR176 dispatch, and n=512 trailing-tiny/rank dispatch behavior without cross-size regressions; validate dense, mixed, and rank-deficient cases around n=32/176/512, and avoid n=352/n=1024 exploration beyond dispatch isolation.

Extend parent 043c8be3a67d6f7b186cd0733e48d1938bd39480 with a dense n=352 QR path: profile current fallback, then add either a padded 512-lane Triton Householder QR352 kernel or a two-panel blocked QR352 variant targeting occupancy/register pressure, preserving QR32/QR176/n512 dispatch and enabling QR352 only if it validates and benchmarks faster than fallback.

Combine current best QR32/QR176/n512 structured-rank dispatch from 043c8be with only the conservative n=1024 rank-640 trailing-tiny classifier from 782fad5, preserving existing QR32, QR176, n512, and n1024 gates; validate dense/mixed fallbacks and revert any dispatch or accuracy regression.

Target remaining dense/mixed n=512 fallback bottleneck by adding a conservative gated blocked n512 QR path: reuse/extend existing Triton QR32/QR176 kernels for panels or trailing-tile updates on well-conditioned full-rank dense n512 cases, validate residual/orthogonality, and preserve all QR32/QR176/trailing-tiny-rank dispatch fallbacks unless this n512 path improves.

Tune only the existing QR32 and QR176 Triton kernels from current best: sweep local launch/codegen knobs such as warps, stages, store/mask layout, cache modifiers, unroll/register-pressure hints, and QR176 8-warp alternatives, preserving all dispatch thresholds and non-target kernels; keep only validating variants that improve active-set geomean.

Salvage n1024 rank/nearrank acceleration by redesigning the classifier to avoid dense/mixed overhead: add one cheap sampled tail precheck before any full tail scan or head geqrf, dispatch the reduced-rank path only on clearly tiny trailing columns, preserve QR32/QR176/n512 exactly, and keep only if n1024 nearrank improves without geomean regression.

Target dense n=352 with a low-code-size blocked Householder QR: keep existing QR32/QR176/n512 dispatch unchanged, factor 32- or 44-column panels using torch.geqrf or a tiny reusable Triton panel kernel, then apply compact WY/trailing rank-k updates in one or two generic Triton kernels reused across panels. Avoid full static unroll and per-column dynamic Triton loops; keep only if n352 improves without regressing current wins.

Target untouched dense large-shape fallback from 4db6144037ccf302cd6ae21a390389ca923df71d: profile n=2048 batch=8 and n=4096 batch=2 torch.geqrf, then shape-gate exact large dense cases to compare full-batch geqrf versus chunked/per-matrix geqrf with optional CUDA stream concurrency; preserve QR32/QR176/n512/n1024 dispatch exactly, avoid Triton QR rewrites, and keep only if large-shape timings improve without geomean regression.

From parent 4db6144037ccf302cd6ae21a390389ca923df71d, target mixed n=512 by replacing the batch-wide trailing-tiny gate with conservative per-matrix selection: reuse Triton tail flags to identify only rank-258 or rank-384 matrices with tiny trailing columns, compact those selected rows into a reduced geqrf call and scatter padded H/tau back, leave dense/uncertain rows on torch.geqrf, and keep only if mixed plus rankdef/clustered n512 improve with no QR32/QR176 or dense n512 regression. Prototype rank-384 first; add rank-258 only if overhead is amortized.

Combine global-best QR352 two-panel path from d731593 with QR32/QR176 num_stages=1 launch tuning from 4db614, using d731 as the anchor; preserve QR32, QR176, QR352, and n512 dispatch gates, apply stage tuning consistently to QR176 including QR352 bottom panel, validate active sizes, and keep only if score preserves or improves d731.

Profile and locally tune the QR352 two-panel path in parent 4081ed585ecc4b7709a2d17f5135ac68dfa0e287: focus on torch.geqrf(352x176), torch.ormqr, and QR176 bottom-panel overhead; try QR352-only num_stages/warps, copy elimination, and output-buffer reuse while preserving QR32/QR176/n512 dispatch, keeping changes only if active score improves.

Profile QR352 two-panel path allocation/synchronization overhead, then try one QR352-only implementation that removes avoidable intermediate materialization before/after first-panel geqrf/ormqr: replace safe zeros/contiguous/clone temporaries with preallocated torch.empty buffers or views, preserve dispatch and QR32/QR176/n512 behavior exactly, and keep only if active score improves.

Combine current global-best c190 QR32/QR176/QR352 stack with 335dab n512 mixed per-matrix rank-258/rank-384 row selection: use c190 as base, preserve QR352 and homogeneous n512 gates exactly, port mixed row compaction/scatter only under safe mixed-rank predicates, validate dense/mixed/rank-deficient n512 cases, profile if conflicts arise, and keep only if total score matches or improves c190 without QR352 regression.

Target exactly n=1024 dense/mixed fallback with a low-code-size blocked two-panel QR: preserve existing QR32/QR176/QR352/n512 gates, factor A[:,0:512] via torch.geqrf, apply Q1.T to A[:,512:1024] via torch.ormqr without forming Q, factor A[512:1024,512:1024] via torch.geqrf, assemble LAPACK-style compact H with right-panel reflectors only in the bottom-right block and tau concatenated, and keep only if n1024 improves with no geomean regression.

Profile only the n512 mixed rank-258/rank-384 per-matrix row-selection path; reduce compaction/scatter/index-materialization overhead with threshold/order tweaks, cached/reused selection metadata, and all-dense/all-selected fast exits, while leaving QR32/QR176/QR352 and homogeneous n512 gates unchanged; keep only validated score improvements.

Use bcfa as base and port only faac's QR352 tail-view ormqr materialization tuning, preserving bcfa QR32/QR176/QR352 paths plus n512 mixed/homogeneous gates; validate n352 full/rank-def and n512 mixed/rank-def cases, benchmark total score, and keep only if it preserves or improves bcfa.

Target only dense/uncertain n=512 fallback from bcfa68388a9db114c35986c9fb490c95e60862d8 with an exact low-code-size two-panel library QR: preserve QR32/QR176/QR352 and all existing n512 trailing-tiny/mixed rank gates; for remaining n512 batch640, compare torch.geqrf fallback against geqrf(A[:,:,:256]) + ormqr(Q1.T,A[:,:,256:]) + geqrf(bottom-right 256x256) compact H/tau assembly, trying one reduced-copy assembly variant; keep only if dense or mixed n512 improves and total geomean does not regress.

Independently eliminate duplicate n512 rank-258/rank-384 all-selected and partial-selection tail-mask work by computing one Triton tail-mask scan per rank and reusing its result across both selection checks; preserve faac QR352 tail-view ormqr tuning, profile parent first, and validate all n512 selection cases.
